function_role: Standard MSVC compiler-generated security cookie check (`@__security_check_cookie@4`) that verifies the stack canary in `ecx` against the global security cookie `___security_cookie` and triggers a failure handler if corruption is detected.

callsite_summaries.0x00419CDB: Invoked via a tail-call (`jmp`) when a stack security cookie mismatch is detected (`jnz loc_4198FC`), serving as the terminal handler for buffer overflow / stack corruption detection (GS failure reporting).
